blocks.text: INN NEWS - when several other presidential candidates (Capres) were still adem ayem, Anies Baswedan had held a magnificent political oration of American style in Senayan Ishora, Jakarta.
By beating up Anies Baswedan and delivering his political oration in front of thousands of sympathizers.
Anies highlighted social inequality as the main narrative. Must still praise Jokowi for building the freeway, Anies confirmed that it remains a jokowi antitesa.
As a concept, Anies called his greatest strength today the spiritual power.
Anies even proudly declared his promise to use that spiritual power to win Pilkada DKI 2017.
What kind of spiritual power does Anies mean by that?

If 2017's success is in reference, it's obvious that the spiritual force intended is a wave of demonstrations cited-volume 212. Behind Anies is also clearly HTI, FPI supporters and former slayed-out terrorists in Jokowi.
With this indirectly Anies did use the political pathetic identity at the time of Pilkada 2017. All this time the Anies tried to avoid being called winning with political identity.

Now the Anies can no longer be evasive, and history will continue to record that the ideology it's carrying is not nationalist. Unlike Jokowi or Ganjar who are still firmly in nationalist ideology today.
Elections will be here any minute, Anies will definitely activate his spiritual power to jack up his voice.
If indeed the spiritual power of Anies is the political identity of 2017, the national remark spread in the educational movement was just a political drivel.
